description: The browser player's deck in spec 19, saved as Deck 2 (deck index 1) so that the Best-of-1 game proves the lobby queues the deck the player CHOSE rather than the first one, and picked as trio slot 1 for game 1 of the series. SPEC §8 cards #61-#80: twenty distinct non-Token Core ids (L2, L3, L6). No card is ever played: the spec reads the opening hand and concedes, so what matters is only that every card the hand can hold is a card of this deck. Nothing here puts a non-Token card into a hand at the opening (no Discover or copy on draw; #65's Quickdraw only guarantees itself), so any hand card that is not a Token (The Coin, R245) must come from this list.
